description: OxidANT's Renovate config. Everything shared lives in the preset at ContainerHub's repository root (default.json); the `extends` line below is the whole adoption, exactly as in the four top-level consumers.

The part this repo cannot get any other way is the git-submodules manager, which Renovate DISABLES by default. third_party/ContainerHub is the pin the Linux and Windows lanes run their gates from, and until 2026-09-09 it had drifted 54 commits behind while three cargo drivers this repo's CI calls by path were deleted upstream as unreachable -- because .github/consumers.json did not list this repository either. Nothing watches a gitlink here without this line.
.gitmodules names `branch = main` for that submodule, which is what the manager needs to know what tip to bump towards.

.github/dependabot.yml is deliberately still present. It covers cargo and the pinned GitHub Actions, and its own header explains why it declares no docker ecosystem. The hand-over is a separate decision; see the note at the top of that file.

Renovate resolves `github>Kataglyphis/ContainerHub` from ContainerHub's DEFAULT BRANCH, not from the pin in third_party/ContainerHub, so a preset change reaches this repo only after it is merged there. And this file stays inert until the Renovate GitHub App is installed on this repository -- no bot has ever authored a commit here. Until then the local CLI reads it: third_party/ContainerHub/docs/dependency-updates.md.
